## Qualified and published — 2026-10-08

The original exact AppImage at mode0644 refuses with126. Actual old/fixed package-function controls preserve bytes and install0755; the real target AppImage executes and renders. The separately exposed library dependency is qualified under #523.

Product integration `e6645cb5ea5ae3c7f699390a74b22d098fbeb7fb` and [retained proof](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/tree/bc4ae05d30531516ebd19b6b167fc994f368c4c3/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-08-save-repair-cases) are published on next `bc4ae05d30531516ebd19b6b167fc994f368c4c3`; ES integration is `4e410dc9a816cc947f16235ad2b24824b29dd84e`. The independent delta audit (#507), assembled firmware inclusion/public adoption (#508), affected device builds and release gates remain separate. #519 must pass before the owner's next handheld update transfer/reboot. No personal cloud or physical action was part of this qualification.

The sections below retain the problem, requirement and investigation history; this status supersedes their earlier in-progress observations.

## Problem and placement

Found while preparing #521's actual GENERIC_X64 DuckStation screenshot proof. The accepted image contains the exact package-pinned AppImage without executable permission, so both shipped launchers cannot start it. This is an existing packaging defect, not a failure of the new screenshot helper.

## Code trace and reproduction

- `projects/ROCKNIX/packages/emulators/standalone/duckstation-sa/package.mk` installs the downloaded AppImage with `cp -a`, preserving download-cache permissions. Both game and Tools launchers execute `/usr/bin/duckstation-sa` directly.
- The owned candidate16-based guest readback at 2026-10-08 06:41 UTC reports mode0644, size90788128 and SHA256 `b204886bb498ede1a290215fc2efb521c0c2f26b964788df697b4fc2cb3f7f7b`, exactly the pinned x64 recipe artifact. `test -x` returns1; direct `--help` returns126/Permission denied. No chmod was applied before this reproduction.
- Required fix: set the installed executable mode explicitly in the recipe, independently of source/cache mode. Preserve exact AppImage bytes and the recipe's strip protection. Do not change the global download cache or treat a temporary guest chmod as the product fix.
- Already written: affected images contain the intact but non-executable application; no save/capture payload repair is implied. A newly assembled fixed image must replace its mode correctly while keeping persistent state unchanged.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Retained actual-image readback proves the original pinned bytes/mode and direct execution refusal; source trace identifies the mode-preserving package operation.
- [x] A package install fixture starts with mode0644 and proves final mode0755 plus byte identity, with an unfixed recipe control that fails the same assertion. Package lint passes.
- [x] The actual guest receives the qualified packaged file/mode and can execute the real AppImage entrypoint. Record any distinct downstream runtime prerequisite honestly; permission repair alone is not screenshot/gameplay proof.
- [x] #521 proof and #508/#507 scope include the fixed package input; final firmware inclusion remains separately gated.

Can this be done on the VM? Yes. Package install controls run in disposable host staging, and the existing owned GENERIC_X64 guest proves actual target execution. No physical device, personal saves, cloud credentials or extra guest is needed.
